text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development. When developers write code, they can easily overlook small errors or logical flaws. A fresh pair of eyes, usually a teammate, can spot these mistakes quickly. This helps in catching bugs early, before they become costly problems in the final product. Beyond finding errors, code reviews are excellent for knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn new techniques from senior colleagues, while everyone gains a better understanding of different parts of the project. Ultimately, this process builds a stronger team, as it encourages communication, responsibility, and a shared commitment to producing high-quality work.
